acceptance.rule: screen one seed pair; confirm with all eight paired evaluations; accept when the proxy or changed board clears the margin with a one-sided 95% lower bound, subject to board and condition loss limits

directives.w0: Improve the E12.5 forecast as a whole population: keep real latest-stage cells, keep the chamber rule and the blood share, and move cells part of the way along the observed per-type trend (kNN-smoothed, damped with horizon) or reweight a few coarse compartments with a priori strengths. Use temporal_val and temporal_heartonly aggregate scores only.
directives.w1: Test one response mechanism that should transfer across knockout genes (Gata4, Mab21l2, Hand2, Mef2c, the unseen gene and Ctnnb1): response size and delay, realism of the resampled cells (mmd_u, variogram), or gene direction from the GO prior. Keep every dev gene level or better.
directives.w2: Under sampling='heart_dissected' build a heart-centric crop of the latest stage (organ-resident cell types and their spatial neighbourhood; drop surrounding tissue), then grow it to the forecast size; leave the with-surroundings path unchanged. Public test: heart-centric crops of E10.5 scored 62.8-66.4 vs our 48.6.
directives.w3: Geometry stays on one native embryo (native_occupancy gate). Improve expression and neighbourhoods: e.g. transfer later-bracket states onto native positions by expression-and-position matching, interpolate composition by fraction, keep whole real profiles.
directives.w4: The Codex heart's dissected weighting is soft (ORGAN_BLEND 0.45 blend). Make the dissected path a hard heart-centric crop, then test the top public family's per-type pseudobulk offset of real cells (20-30% of the damped trend). Isolate one change per cycle.
directives.w5: Geometry stays on one native embryo (native_occupancy gate). Improve the cell-state distribution: partial transport of earlier-bracket cells toward matched later states (whole profiles, not gene edits), or a better position assignment for later-bracket cells that preserves local neighbourhood composition.

_models: 2026-11-19 user decision: every role runs GPT-6.2-Sol through codex exec (no DeepSeek, GLM or Claude). No overflow role: when the codex quota window closes, workers pause until it reopens.
_selection: T1 and T2 lines hill-climb on dev (paired acceptance, 3-day sanity gate for T1/heart); final keeps the scored seed for T1/T2 and lists their dev-best programs in final.json review_candidates. T3 is promoted only by a paired win over Enigma w1_c17 on the calibrated splits plus the unseen-gene veto. Research evaluations use the fleet; finalization is local.
_t1: Seed: first-bundle sampler + heart-chamber donor rule (x0.05 non-cardiac) + blood at 0.8x its last-input share. t1_composition_veto = the T1 blood guard (agentic_scientist/composition.py): test-configuration forecast blood-like share <= the E10.5 input's; applied to every T1 candidate and to the seed at final. Agents see the verdict only.
_t2: Heart: half the board on dissected targets (heart_organ_proxy, heart_e875_organ). Embryo: dev scored without shape metrics (they rank native geometry below overlays, opposite to the test); native single-embryo geometry is enforced by embryo_native_min on metrics.native_occupancy.
